d: Lou and Sonia find themselves in the middle of a baffling marital spat involving a man, his wife, and her untrustworthy yoga instructor
It's payback time when Lou, Matt, and Froy stake out the baseball bus that got away and this time, they've got a foolproof plan
Sonia and Matt have an unpleasant confrontation with a group of skateboarding ruffians who don't want to give up their car
Sonia and Froy get locked in the battle of a lifetime with a pair of young debtors who are understandably upset that their late model Tahoe has found its way to the bottom of a lake
Lyndah has some tension with Frankie when they repo a truck from a moving company in the middle of relocating some fragile material for a very important client
Sonia and Froy repossess an experimental concept motorcycle from a hose-wielding yuppie

First, Sonia and Lou deal with a terrible boss and his instigating employees. Next, Lou, Froy, and Lyndah deal with a debtor with issues when they take possession of a taco truck. And Finally, Matt, Lou, and Sonia take on a big repo at a dealership and come out with six cars.
The repo team's new truck finally arrives, and with it, a new chapter in the building feud between Team Lou and Team Matt.
Will a frying pan-wielding housewife stop Lou and Sonia from getting their car? Plus, a repo involving a truck filled with black market contraband goes horrifyingly wrong for Matt and Froy.
On this no-holds-barred season finale, Matt and Lou have their final confrontation and the team loses a member

Lou and Froy repo a vehicle in a bad part of town and somebody gets punched in the face. Then, Sonia and Lyndah interrupt a tennis match to retrieve an automobile. Plus, Matt and Froy confront an out-of-control director in the middle of a shoot.
Lou and his cousin Rob face trouble on the job when a debtor makes shocking claims to police about the newest member of the Pizarro clan
Sonia and Froy storm a studio to repossess a Corvette from a surly European photographer and his hapless, bikini-clad subjects
Sonia and Froy get messy when they head to Venice Beach to track down and recover a canoe from the world-famous canals

t: I Don't Know What That Is
d: Matt and Froy crash a raucous brew-fest to sneak an ATV away from a crowd of tipsy revelers
